findings.quote: saying that it was not possible to admit any new member apart from Philip and the other allies
findings.problem: Greek: οὐ φάσκοντες δυνατὸν εἶναι χωρὶς Φιλίππου καὶ τῶν συμμάχων οὐδένα προσλαβεῖν = it was not possible to admit anyone WITHOUT Philip and the allies (i.e. without their consent). The English 'apart from' reads as an exception (only Philip and the allies could be admitted), inverting the sense.
findings.proposed_fix: saying that it was not possible to admit anyone without Philip and the allies
